description: This file contains the implementation of a hasher class 'Orleans3CompatibleStringKeyHasher' for Orleans v3, specifically designed for string-only grain key IDs. It includes methods for hashing byte arrays and identifying if data matches a grain type name, utilizing buffer management and external hashing components.

classes.name: Orleans3CompatibleStringKeyHasher
classes.description: An internal class implementing IHasher for generating hashes of string-only grain key IDs compatible with Orleans v3, with logic to handle grain type name detection and buffer extension.

methods.name: Orleans3CompatibleStringKeyHasher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the hasher with an inner hasher and grain type string.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash for the provided byte array, extending data if necessary, and handling special cases when data matches the grain type name.

methods.name: IsGrainTypeName
methods.description: Determines if the given byte array matches the grain type name by comparing UTF-8 encoded bytes.
